method.transport: loopback HTTP; response download and JSON parse included
method.stageTiming: optional benchmark-only synchronous wrappers; inclusive totalMs and exclusive selfMs; do not sum inclusive times
method.signatureInput: createHmac-to-first-update interval in District proof: normalization, canonicalization and JSON serialization combined; crypto calls timed separately
method.stageRemainder: server time outside exclusive stage spans, including route validation, response serialization and HTTP; District selfMs includes its remaining validation and delta work
method.verification: sha256 of canonical revision/chunks/objects/generators; object-key order ignored, array order preserved
method.history: optional undo/redo followed by unmeasured verification reads
method.expansion: client delta reconstruction measured separately in preview/apply rows as expandMs; browser reconciliation is not measured
method.cache: warm filesystem/OS cache; one unrecorded warm-up; no forced server GC
method.memory: server heap after each request; RSS and lifetime process peak; fixture built outside the server
method.viewport: four published chunks; object metadata is not spatially filtered by the current store
method.p95: nearest-rank; with 5 samples p95 equals the maximum
method.exclusions: browser rendering/FPS, Wi-Fi latency, physical devices and Windows are not measured
